results.overview: Leila, trapped in an abusive marriage, secretly seeks a divorce. When her husband Amir uncovers her secret, the fragile balance of lies collapses. Hidden truths emerge, and a terrifying night reveals the real predator in a chilling climax.

results.title: Pechi
results.overview: Five young trekkers and their tour guide embark on a weekend adventure in the Kollimalai hills. Despite warnings, they venture into a restricted area, unknowingly entering the domain of a malevolent spirit, which is hell bent on wreaking havoc in their lives. Did they survive the relentless onslaught and harrowing encounter with the supernatural force in the haunted woods?

results.title: Queens
results.overview: Surrounded by social and political chaos in Lima during the summer of 1992, Lucia, Aurora, and their mother, Elena, plan to leave and seek opportunities in the United States. Their farewell involves reconnecting with their estranged father, Carlos, adding turbulence to the regrets, hopes, and fears of their emotional departure.

results.title: Sweaty Larry
results.overview: Three curious young girls stumble upon an obscure urban legend and dare to summon an entity known as Sweaty Larry. A brand new spin on the Bloody Mary tale that begs the question...why is he so sweaty?

results.title: Bedlamer

results.title: Avicii - I'm Tim
results.overview: Before Avicii, there was Tim. Through his own words, witness how a prodigious musical talent became one of the defining artists of his generation.

results.title: The Line
results.overview: Tom, a passionate ‘brother’ of his fraternity, is charmed by the promises of high social status and alumni connections that open doors. But as Annabelle, a classmate outside his social circle, enters his life, his devotion begins to falter. Once the scheduled hazing of new fraternity members comes to a disturbing head, Tom faces the decision of a lifetime.

results.title: I Used to Be Funny
results.overview: Sam, an aspiring stand-up comedian and au pair struggling with PTSD, weighs whether to join the search for Brooke, a missing teenage girl she used to nanny. As she fights to recover from her trauma and return to the stage, memories of her deep bond with Brooke rush back—making it impossible to ignore her disappearance.

results.title: justicia!
results.overview: Amazon drivers in Palmdale, CA are on strike against Amazon's unfair labor practices, unsafe jobs, and low pay. NYC Teamsters show solidarity and ask for justice, now!

results.title: Bystanders
results.overview: Abby and her friends attend a frat party, but it turns into a nightmare when they are drugged and hunted for sport. As Abby escapes, a mysterious couple arrives and they’re ready to turn the tables on the predators.

results.title: Take Cover
results.overview: A burned-out professional sniper finds himself trapped in an all-glass penthouse by a lethal competitor and must find a way to survive and escape with little to no cover between him and the killer.
